THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE UMESH M ADIGA
ORAL JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the claimant being aggrieved by Judgment and Award dated 29.06.2018 passed in MVC No.292/2017 by the Principal Judge, Small Causes Court and MACT Mysuru,
seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. This appeal is slated for admission.
With the consent, it is taken up for final disposal.
3. Parties are referred to as per their rankings before the Tribunal.

4. Brief facts of the case are that:
On 12.08.2016 at about 9.30 p.m. opposite to Oriental Research Institute, Mysuru,
claimant met with an NC: 2025:KHC:45030 HC-KAR accident due to rash and negligent riding of motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-45-S-0542 (for short `offending vehicle').
As a result, claimant sustained injuries.
He underwent surgery and spent substantial amount towards medical expenses.
He suffered permanent disability.
With these reasons, claimant prayed to award compensation of Rs.15,00,000/-.
5. Respondent No.1 was the owner and respondent No.2 was the insurer of the offending vehicle.
Respondent No.1 remained exparte and respondent No.2 in its written statement denied petition averments and denied its liability to pay the compensation and prayed to dismiss the claim petition.
6. Tribunal framed necessary issues, recorded the evidence of the parties and on appreciation of the evidence on record held that accident occurred due to negligence of rider of the motorcycle.

Tribunal in all awarded a compensation of Rs.3,10,100/- as under:

7. Heard the arguments.
8.
There is no dispute in respect of the accident in question and injuries sustained by the claimant in the said accident.
Therefore there is no need to reconsider the same.
9. Claimant sustained fracture of left tibia Proximal 1/3rd.

He underwent surgery,
implants were fixed at the fractured area.
According to PW2, claimant has suffered permanent disability of 10% of the whole body.

The Tribunal has taken the age of the claimant as 30 years, applied multiplier `17' and assessed the income at Rs.9,000/-
per month and on that basis calculated the NC: 2025:KHC:45030 HC-KAR compensation on the head `loss of future earning capacity due to permanent disability'.
10.

It is contended in the appeal memo that income assessed by the Tribunal is on the lower side and it is also urged that the amount of compensation awarded under other heads are meagre and prayed to enhance the compensation.
11. Learned counsel for respondent No.2/insurer fairly submits that the Tribunal has taken income at Rs.9,000/- per month.
As per the chart prepared by the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority the notional income can be taken at Rs.9,500/- per month.

He further contends that amount of compensation awarded under other heads are just and reasonable and it does not call for any interference.
